contract.input: A versioned fixture, deterministic command sequence and named expectations.
contract.step: Call the same public boundary as player hosts.
Group scenarios by contract: core, attention, persistence, projections and delivery.
Run affected groups first; run complete integration before main publication.
contract.invariant: Selecting a block does not delete scenarios or weaken historical integrity.
contract.reject: Report missing tools as pending, never as a passing skipped test.

test.given: A bounded attention block is selected.
test.when: Warden executes its complete scenario inventory.
test.then: Report named expected/actual values, inventory and the remaining integration gate.
